translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 2 Corintios
book.title: Corintogi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Irbogus Garda Narmaksad 2 Corintios

content: Ar anmar nue wismalad, anmar-san-we-napneggined dordo-negyob-guedi surgusale, gwen akarsulid. Ar Bab Dummad anmarga neg-binidyob, san-gwapid nibneggi ukoed. We-san geg-bergued, dule-argangi-sobarsulidid, degi-sadeguoed-negad.
A-ulale anmar we-san-an-sedimaladgi an agigindimarsunnad, bitigi anmar-san-nibalid, an nikudapmaloedse nadena-gadinye an binsadimarsunnad,
adi anmar nibneggi megdapogua, anmar-san, mor-yolegedyob guegar, mer uka-swirigwadyob guegar.

Amba deyob we-san dordo-negyob-gued-an-sedimaladgi nunmakedba an agigindimalad. Ar anmarde uka-swiri gubisulid, san-binid bur an yobimalad, adi san-we-napneggi-sunna-bergued, burba-duladse berguegar, adi dula anmar degi-gudigu-sadeguegar.
Ar a-ular Bab Dummad anmar-obinnidsad, degine, anmarga E-Burba-Nued-iduakwaa-uksabalid, anmarga oyogegar, ede nue-napiragwad ibmar-nuegan anmarga imakoye.
Degisoggu, a-ulale anmar bensuli gudimarsunnad, ar anmar wisid, amba we-sangi an gudimalale, anmar Bab-Jesús-walikasurmalad.
Ar anmar Jesús-sanar-daksurmar-inigwele, degite Jesúsgi bensuli anmar nanadimalad.
Ar an nue wismalad, we-san-an-sedimaladgi an bangusmalana-gadinye binsadimalad, adi Bab-Jesús-walik an gudigumalagar.
Degisoggu, anmar bia gudii-dibe, sangin-dibe, sangi bangus gudii-dibe, Bab-Jesús bur-yeer-itoged an imakbimalad.
Ar ade anmar bela Cristo-igar-itogoed-asabin gwisgumaloed-biid, adi anmar na wala-walagwen anmar-sangi-ibmar-imaksadba nued imaksa-dibe, igi, ibmar-iskana imaksa-dibe, aba ibmar-abingamalagar.
Bab Dummad, dulemar-ebo igar naboged

Ar Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanaed anmar wissoggu, a-ular anmar dulemargi alamaknaimarsunnad, adi Jesúsba nagumalagar. Ar Bab Dummad nue-anmar-wisid anmar igi damala, degine, bemar nue-anmar-wisi-wilubmarmogad anmar igi damalad.
Anmar na dukin bemarga sogsurmalad, anmar dule-nuegan gumarye. We anmar bur imaked, bemar anmargi yeer-itoged, adi bemar dulemar-unnila-askinbi-ibmar-dakmalad, gwagegi-ibmar-daksurmalad-abinsaegar.
Ar akarguarye anmar-nik soglealile, we Bab Dummadga anmar deyob gudido. Anmar gwen akarsurye anmar-nik soglegele, we bemarga anmar deyobdo.
Ar Cristo anmar-sabgued deyob-dae-anmar-imaked. Anmar weyob binsaed, Cristo bela dulemarga burgwisale, bela anmar bato burgwismarmodo.
Cristo bela dulemarga burgwisad, adi dulemar-dula-gudimalad, melle na ega bar gudigumalagar, dule ega burgwisadga, ega durgusadga, aga dula gudigumalagar.
Degisoggu, a-ulale, we-napneg-igar-maid dakedyob dulemar bar an daksurmalad. Ar iduar we-napneg-igar-maidba an Cristo-daksamar-inigwele, emigindi bar deyob an Cristo-daksurmalad.
Degisoggu, dule-wargwen Cristogi akanonikile, dule-gwapidga gunoni-dasunnad. Ibmar-sergandi bela ega bato nassunnad, emigindi bela ibmar-biniganbi ega gunonisunnad.
We-ibmar bela Bab Dummadgi danikid, ar Bab Dummad na dukin anmarbo Cristogi igar-naboged-imaksad, degine, anmarga we-igar uksad, adi dulemar Bab-Dummad-ebo igar-nabogegar.
Bab Dummad Cristogi dulemar-we-napneggi-bukmalad-ebo igar nabosad, dulemar iskudimaladgi Bab Dummad bar binsa dasulid. Degine, Bab Dummad dulemar-ebo igar-nabogedgi sunmakega anmarga igar uksad.
Degisoggu, anmar Cristo-nuggi barmilealidga gunonisunnad. Bab Dummad anmarba dulemarse wilesakwaa egisnaiyob, anmar Cristo-nuggi bemarse wilesun: Bab-Dummad-ebo bemar igar-nabomarsunye.
Cristo-dule-iskussulid, dule-iskusadyob gunonikid, adi Bab Dummad iskussuliyob Cristogi-anmar-dakegar.
